minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, February 16, 2022
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, February 16, 2022.
  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Lorraine Missick, Jenny Jolly, Bette
  Donovan and Scott Snider.
  Members absent: None.
  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Manager and Amanda Triay,
  Community Services Specialist.
  Guests present: None.
  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, November
  17, 2021 meeting. Motion carried.
  Unfinished Business
2. Senior Nutrition Program: For the Grab-n-Go meals, there were an average of 81
  meals distributed per week in November 2021, an average of 77 meals distributed
  per week in December 2021, and an average of 82 meals distributed per week in
  January 2022.

3. Guest Speaker: None.

4. Bingo Report: There were a total of 48 in attendance at the first session back
  together. All bills are paid for paper and new table covers are to be ordered. The
  issue of finding new callers has been resolved, as new applications have been
  turned in. The current Bingo balance is $3,780.35.

5. Meals on Wheels: 730 meals were served to 38 La Verne recipients in November
  2021, 795 meals were served to 41 La Verne recipients in December 2021, and 400
  meals were served to 44 La Verne recipients in January 2022.for an average of 48
  meals per day. A total of 1,008 meals were distributed in San Dimas and La Verne
  combined.

6. Account Balance: $4,141.49

7. Senior Program Fees: All fees have been paid for November and December 2021.
  Garden Friends may no longer be meeting at the Community Center..
 8. MT. SAC Classes: Spring classes begin the week of February 21, 2022.

9. Aging Next: 8 meals were delivered and 28 individuals were provided with case
  management in November 2021. 16 meals were delivered and 34 individuals were
  provided with case management in December 2021. 20 meals were delivered and
  32 individuals were provided with case management in January 2022. An upcoming
  meeting will be held at the Community Center.

  New Business

10. Upcoming Events:
  Thursday, March 3rd –International Line Dancing resumes, open class 10:00 AM-
  12:00 PM. Class will be held every Thursday.
  Monday, March 14th –Movie Matinee, 12:30 PM
  Wednesday, March 30th –Sidewalk Coloring Contest, 9:30 AM

11. Facilities Report: During the January windstorms a tree fell in front of Veterans Hall
  but all cleanup has been completed. The Weber House was also hit by fallen trees,
  causing damage to some fencing. These repairs are still being worked on.

12. Public Comments: Yvonne mentioned the City of La Verne has a new Fire Chief and
  new Police Chief. She also noted that in the event of a City emergency, residents
  should call City Hall for help. Additionally, she shared that Francis, a longtime
  volunteer, passed away at 101 years old. A Memorial Service will be held on
  Saturday, March 5th, at 9:00 AM. There will not be a City Council Meeting held on
  March 22nd; information on this can be found in the Community News Letter. It was
  also noted that there has been a lot of positive feedback in regards to the Recreation
  Guide now being mailed out to households in La Verne. Paulina will be leaving but
  will continue to work for the city part time. Robyn Olsen is now at the Front Desk and
  Ricardo Aguilar has obtained the position of part-time Recreation Specialist. All
  positions for the Community Center have now been filled.

  Scott gave an update on Hillcrest. They are starting to open up more; however,
  Assisted Living is not able to mingle with others yet. Their art display is now back as
  well.

  George gave and update on Golf. The group is currently averaging 20 players. He
  also shared that 60 trees came down at Marshall Canyon during the wind storm.

  Lastly, Lorraine mentioned that the San Dimas Center is having monthly dinners.
 13. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 11:00 AM. Motion
  carried. The next meeting will be held at the Community Center on March 16, 2022
  at 10:00 AM.
